notes.title: TOBOR Arrives on November 16th, 2023
notes.content:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2081310/TOBOR/

[previewyoutube=LyhdxRrUWrs;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658268/8b7ebab1219367bbaba69ade783d0781b1a4a048.png[/img]

TOBOR is an experimental story-based surveillance simulation game where the player plays as Tobor, a spy robot of RA Corporation, and explore ‘Undercroft’ using a surveillance system. Depending on the many choices that the player makes, players can enjoy not only changing the story inside the surveillance feeds, but also experience multiple endings.

The game was inspired by New York experimental theatre “Sleep No More”.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658268/1c45ee1cbb91c9dd6269a0abaf6baa3aafb0a3a1.png[/img]

While the objective of Tobor is to observe the inhabitants, there is much revealed along the way of what connections undercroft has with a character named Dr. Goralini. The gamer gathers intelligence by eavesdropping and scanning objects and uses their wits to make choices throughout the game leading to a different ending. The player is given 6 days to accomplish their given mission. The official release will reveal all the endings of the game.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658268/dca974c56006e227ef289708152d729204429e24.png[/img]

- Single Player 2D surveillance simulation game 
- A compelling tragic story with 5 characters to follow
- Investigate to find out the truth about ‘Undercroft’ 
- Observe 16 camera feeds that run simultaneously
- Learn to use the surveillance system to eavesdrop, scan objects and gather intelligence
- Find out the truth behind the weird dreams that become a reality
- Be careful on the choices you make as it will change the story
- Choices Matter game with multiple endings
- Language support available for English, Korean

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658268/5e3fcdc0843da9553695d3693ce9fb90953054b1.png[/img]

- Observe LIVE FEEDS of FIVE SUBJECTS
- All the subjects have their own background story and personality
- They all react differently to the same event that occurs in the same space
- Replay the game to see the different perspectives

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42658268/054c77d1faabec37e9ade380761b22225f56f6bc.png[/img]

We plan to release media and press steam keys a little early! 
If you are media or press, feel free to checkout our PR Kit and reach out to us.

notes.title: [Rocco's island] Update Ver. 1.2.1 Note
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38668918/1b5beba7e3c3ae0a83d9a17280efc284c31051be.jpg[/img]
Hello All, 

We are very excited to announce our update release ver. 1.2.1 today. Thank you everyone for playing. 

During the production stage of the game in November 2021, we were really happy with the translations of the text and dialogue of the game and we reached out to our localization company to include the names of the translators. We were notified that it was their policy not to disclose their names. Hence we were not able to include the names of the many translators who really helped us make the game great. 

A few weeks ago, we were lucky to find some great people reaching out to us over twitter with disappointment that the translators were not included in the credit section of the game. So we reached out to our localization company with the issue and they have agreed to send us the names of the many translators who we really think they have earned their spots in the credits. 

We are very happy to let everyone know that on this update, our credit section of the game now includes the names of the translators. We are more than happy to do so, and hope that many other developers can join too. #Translatorsinthecredits. 
Special thanks to @Tamslator on Twitter for the effort. 

Thank you once again for the massive work!

Proofreading: Isa Gutiérrez

notes.title: [Rocco's island] Update Ver. 1.2.0 Note
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38668918/e87081101541eafd21c4dc4b1136311aa512b84d.png[/img]
Hello All, 

We are very excited to announce our update release ver. 1.2.0 today. Thank you everyone for playing. A lot of players have expressed that the 3-match puzzle using the time mode was too difficult. We understand that players want to just enjoy the story of the game so we have taken out the time mode on Story mode and Normal Mode. If players want to experience the time mode, it is still available on Hard Mode. 

[Story Mode]: Easy puzzle, recommended to story chasers. Since the game is easy, some leaderboard and achievements will be unavailable on this mode. Time Mode not available. 
[Normal Mode]: Normal puzzle, recommended to puzzle enthusiast players. Time mode is not available. 
[Hard Mode]: Beware, recommended to players who really enjoy the challenge. Time mode is available. 

Enjoy, 

Team Cogoo 

-- On our next update -- 
- We plan to add controller support

notes.title: [Rocco's Island] Official Release Note
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38668918/27a322f9a42ee1143f80045154b012e68a5d510a.png[/img]

Hello All,

We are very excited to announce our official release ver. 1.00 today. Thank you everyone for playing and testing along with us during Early Access. We initially ran a Demo of Rocco's Island during Steam Game Festival in October of 2020. A lot has changed in the course of development throughout the months.

Ring to End the Pain is the first episode of a much wider universe and series of stories that are currently under development. The team hopes that many enjoy the ending of our first episode unveiling the secrets of Rocco's Island.

This project couldn't have been done without the help of many testers and players on Steam community. We want to take this moment to really thank everyone who has been very supportive throughout the way.

Our Original Soundtrack of Rocco's Island: Ring to End the Pain will also be available for you to listen on streaming services very soon. They are also available on our Youtube channel playlist.

Enjoy,

Team Cogoo

-- On our next update --
We plan to add controller support
We plant to add a hard mode just to add a little more challenge

notes.title: [DevLog 070] Rocco's Island Original Sound Track
notes.content:
(Created Sep 11th, by Taeho Kim, Yonghwy Kim & Haewon Lee, Album Cover by Joori Song ) 

Hello all, 

Today we want to begin sharing our original sound track of Rocco's Island. The sound track music has been directed by Yonghwy Kim and been written by artist Taeho Kim and Haewon Lee. To be honest, the whole experience was a very long process since the artist needed to understand the story and personas of the map environment and None playable Characters. 

Since we didn't have all the concepts finished before we started to make the music, it required a lot of research and discussion on what the game will look like in the future. 

Our initial goal was to make an album of the game music as OST to represent the universe we are creating in Rocco's Island. 

The team will be updating this thread revealing one song a day. We will be updating everyday before the early access release coming up very soon. All the songs on the OST will be available on Steam for purchase later.

notes.title: [Devlog 060] A Glance at our main scene title animation and Ui development
notes.content:
Hi! 
As the team is putting together different parts of the game, we started to work on the main title intro scene that introduces the logo. All graphics are work in progress. We only started working on this a few weeks ago, but we really wanted to show you a glimpse of what the scene would look like. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38668918/b40fc605ea1c23618cc10650d97c074281cff816.png[/img]
Joori finished on the logo design a couple of weeks ago. The team animated this logo like it is being painted by a brush. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38668918/a8967fbe0e5625e53391efa5a67dd2745b155051.png[/img]
Then the logo shrinks and moves a little to the top while instantly 4 slots appear. This slot is where players can save their progress while playing the game. Each slot is distinguished by different bossess that appear in the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38668918/66a1c47eeb25c50dc8e8903c9cb1fa156e4250f5.png[/img]
We created dotted UI circling the slot to show which slot is chosen by the player. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38668918/bdb2e80496d8d08dcea395a8e44c6a0f7d9e272c.png[/img]
Once the player clicks the highlighted slot again with the mouse the game automatically starts where the player left off. But just before that we created a logo animation of eva raising her hand just like what she does when she opens a puzzle door in the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38668918/b6725a7de7f3e9ba2a22c73559506258e71a3461.png[/img]
We also created an option UI where the player can set different settings of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38668918/9440df4d459be272a36eb21d2bc0a0984fce464f.png[/img]
The players can change their language, resolution and sound/music volume. We are currently considering to add another performance gage that would turn off all heavy performance duty for the lower end PCs. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38668918/bd02ab5fcdcd42b111bc59a52e823356360f9e4c.png[/img]
Also, once a player finishes their first game play, it is now marked with the mark of Rocco. So players will return to this page once they finish seeing the ending and the credits cinematics. 

[previewyoutube=bFv20rdMYAI;full][/previewyoutube]
With the concept and flow designed by Joori, Jonghyeon has implemented it in the game. You can check the Youtube to see how the details were implemented. 

Upcoming changes.

1) Cinematics concept and Storyboard
2) Additional animation for Jon(fly) and Tet(fossil)
3) Soundfx and BGM integration 

Stay tuned for more updates. 

- Team Cogoo -
